purpose: Situation-first evidence for useful coaching; not automatic profile assignment or statistical diagnosis.

knowledge_review.basis: Existing project knowledge and source contract, not independent re-extraction.

questions.question: After the plant, how did the player help defend a numbers advantage?
questions.start: Plant completion; tracked player alive on T; at least two Ts alive and Ts outnumber living CTs.
questions.population: Every qualifying plant in eligible rounds, including rounds without player damage or later contact.
context_for_interpretation: site and bomb position where known
exclusions: plant/death ordering changes eligibility and cannot be resolved
questions.unknown_policy: Missing tracks do not erase an eligible conversion observation, but spacing, cover and access to a fight remain unresolved.
questions.lesson: Who can respond if a teammate takes contact, and who can contest the bomb?
questions.contrast: Same site with comparable starting counts and objective timing, including timer wins.
questions.claim_ceiling: Observed sequence, team conversion and reviewed spatial transitions. A tradeable death requires a usable route or sightline in time. No intent or causal win credit from counts alone.

questions.question: When the player became the last teammate alive against multiple opponents, what options remained?
questions.start: First transition per round to tracked player as sole surviving teammate against at least two living opponents.
questions.population: All qualifying episodes, retaining no-contact episodes and later transitions to 1v1.
required_for_eligibility: reconciled live roster and death ordering
questions.unknown_policy: Uncertain live counts disqualify eligibility. Missing objective, clock or equipment leaves feasibility of planting, defusing or saving unresolved. Remaining round duration after the fact is not the clock the player knew.
questions.lesson: Identify what the objective and clock still allow before choosing the next fight.
questions.contrast: Same side, starting odds and bomb phase; separate 1v1 numerical parity from an outnumbered start.
questions.claim_ceiling: Describe how observed actions changed options. Opponent positions in replay do not establish player knowledge or intent. No clutch or closer identity from a naked win percentage.

questions.question: When did the player's flash coincide with a teammate fighting an affected opponent?
questions.start: Each attributable tracked-player flash detonation in eligible rounds.
questions.population: All attributable detonations with enemy, team, self and unknown outcomes retained, rather than death-conditioned examples only.
context_for_interpretation: same-opponent teammate weapon damage or kill
questions.unknown_policy: If target, throw attribution, interval or stream coverage is missing, retain the recorded throw/effect and mark overlap unknown. Ambiguous simultaneous grenade attribution cannot be guessed.
questions.lesson: Coordinate the flash timing with the teammate's arrival.
questions.contrast: Similar throw area and teammate approach, including contact after the blind effect expired.
questions.claim_ceiling: A teammate damaged this opponent during the recorded blind interval. Temporal overlap alone is not proof of intended or causal assistance. Smoke delay requires separately validated coverage and movement.

followup_requirements: what future observable behaviour would indicate progress
excluded_claims: verified angle clearing from sampled facing alone
vertical/head-height accuracy without a validated geometry model
reaction time from censored contact windows
continuous input behaviour from a capability probe

aggregate_review.status: Accepted for candidate discovery; no new coaching diagnosis approved

selection_rules: Select by decision question and observable choices, without filtering wins, losses, deaths or successful contact
A matched win/loss pair is exploratory only, never a controlled comparison or certified positive/negative example
Search for contextually useful choices and genuinely disconfirming evidence; preserve observations when alternatives remain unresolved

counting_units.postplant: 142/303 describes opportunity prevalence, not conversion or closing ability
counting_units.last_alive: 21/123 describes transition to 1v1, not clutch success; no damage/kill is not no contact
counting_units.flash: Detonations, blind effect records, overlap links, source event rows and fights are different units; exclude out-of-live-window detonations from live denominators and retain same-tick uncertainty

followup_interpretation.postplant: Observed useful coverage, coordinated responses or avoidance of unnecessary independent exposure in fresh comparable postplants
followup_interpretation.last_alive: Actions reflect objective, time, verified resources and realistic alternatives in comparable starting states
followup_interpretation.flash: Observable coordination with teammate movement/contact in comparable sequences, without simply increasing harmful friendly effects
followup_interpretation.comparability: Use new non-overlapping games and unchanged opportunity definitions; disclose method/coverage breaks; behavior first, outcomes second
